title: Space Shuttle Thermal Tile Demonstration
summary: A two-minute clip recorded on a Kennedy Space Center tour showing a Space Shuttle thermal tile that can be held by hand while its surface is extremely hot. It demonstrates the tile's remarkable insulating properties.
why: Cited as a striking, counterintuitive example of extreme thermal insulation and hard materials science.

quote.text: have a look at this video demonstrating insulating tiles as used on the space shuttle
